purpose: Small verified AOS operating registry for Hermes daily Slack work.

policies.skill_description_rule: Every SKILL.md description is <=60 characters, one sentence, ending with a period.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: Architecture changes, cross-service design, scaling, data models, or technical tradeoffs.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: Simple edits, copy-only changes, or tasks with no structural design choice.
domain_specialists.required_output: Architecture decision memo with options, risks, chosen design, and verification steps.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Check cited files, run relevant build/tests, and confirm design constraints are addressed.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: Authz, secrets, regulated data, trust boundaries, network exposure, or compliance claims.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: Purely cosmetic UI work or local-only refactors without data/access impact.
domain_specialists.required_output: Security/compliance finding list with severity, mitigations, and go/no-go verdict.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Review diffs and run security-relevant tests or static checks where available.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: External facts, citations, market claims, medical/nutrition facts, laws, or vendor comparisons.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: Internal repo facts that can be verified directly from files or tests.
domain_specialists.required_output: Research dossier with cited claims, confidence, recency, and unresolved uncertainty.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Confirm every nontrivial claim has a primary or reputable secondary source.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: Pricing, packaging, GTM, sales narrative, buyer personas, procurement, or monetization tradeoffs.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: Engineering implementation details with no commercial decision.
domain_specialists.required_output: Commercial recommendation with positioning, risks, assumptions, and next experiments.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Check assumptions against evidence and identify claims requiring substantiation.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: Pre-release go/no-go, pilot demo readiness, app store handoff, or production launch checks.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: Early design planning or unmerged local exploratory work.
domain_specialists.required_output: Go/no-go report with blockers, mitigations, owner gates, and release checklist.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Verify tests, artifacts, rollback path, and owner-only walls are satisfied.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: Hazmat, dangerous goods, placards, ERG, TDG/49 CFR, shipping papers, or regulated output.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: General logistics, ordinary product copy, or unsupported legal advice requests.
domain_specialists.required_output: Cited hazmat review with allowed wording, blocked claims, and escalation notes.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Check every regulated assertion against cited authoritative sources.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: Nourish product flows, nutrition behavior, meal planning, nutrient claims, or health-adjacent UX.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: Medical diagnosis, treatment advice, or unrelated product areas.
domain_specialists.required_output: Nourish product review with behavior guidance, claim safety, and UX recommendations.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Verify health/nutrition claims against cited sources and label uncertainty.

domain_specialists.when_to_use: Behavior design, motivation, friction, trust, onboarding, or user comprehension issues.
domain_specialists.when_not_to_use: Backend-only tasks or UI changes with no behavior/user impact.
domain_specialists.required_output: Psychology/UX critique with risks, interventions, and measurable acceptance criteria.
domain_specialists.verification_method: Check recommendations against user evidence, product constraints, and measurable outcomes.

super_specialist_skills.description: Builds threat models for risky changes.
Checks pilot readiness and launch blockers.

worker_templates.purpose: Execute scoped code changes from a task packet; not a decision maker.
Run bounded implementation or refactor lanes; not a council vote.
Run tests and collect evidence; not a release approver.
Update docs from approved source material; not a claims authority.
Summarize Slack threads and extract tasks; not an owner proxy.
Collect repo evidence and findings; not a final auditor.
Execute approved migrations; not a migration approver.
